as_told.title: Langley UFO came round to do a scan

plain: Dylan Borland, a witness who was on the military base at Langley, says that in 2012 a light flew toward him across the base from near the NASA hangar and a triangle formed around it: an equilateral craft one to two stories thick, with 90 degree edges and a flowing gold glow like lava or plasma, and as it took off above him he felt the air go charged. He tells it himself, says he gave it to Congress and to AARO, the Pentagon's current office for unexplained aerial reports, in a classified written record, and thinks the craft came round to do a scan of the base. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell and Michels all retell it from Borland's account, Michels dating it to 2012.
